snippet.title: KILL IT WITH FIRE! 2 - Launch Trailer | Steam, PS5, Xbox Game Pass
snippet.description:
Xbox - https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9mxhl3tt792f 
PlayStation - https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10008124
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2357000/KILL_IT_WITH_FIRE_2/

KILL IT WITH FIRE! 2 OUT NOW on Steam, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S and Game Pass!

KILL IT WITH FIRE! 2 is the ultimate co-op spider-hunting experience! Either solo or as a team of Exterminators, unleash an arsenal of crazy weapons, wreak havoc, and complete dozens of challenges across seven dimensions under spider siege.
